card.name: Words just before breast or chest terms
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a body-area noun such as nipple, breast, chest or underarm, e.g. 'the' or 'under' in 'the chest' or 'underarm'. It also fires on 'and' or 'yearly' in breast-exam sentences.
